about.body_1: I am a medical student exploring graphic design and software development. My work connects visual design with digital tools.
about.body_2: I study medicine, create designs, and build simple digital tools. I aim to make complex ideas clear and easy to use.
about.quote: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do everything in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
